statement: Postpartum mental-health navigation exists as helplines and content (PSI provider directory + 50+ support groups + peer mentors + psychiatric consult line; HelpLine explicitly not crisis; NHS perinatal content + talking-therapies self-referral) and as apps (Canopie self-guided sessions + membership; MamaLift 8-week self-help + prescription-only FDA-cleared MamaLift Plus with SuMMER sham-controlled results); no open self-screen path exists to copy, and crisis lines are services, not products.
evidence: PSI postpartum.net helpline page (fetched 2026-09-17); NHS Every Mind Matters + postnatal depression pages; Canopie store page; Curio MamaLift pages. Accessed 2026-09-17.
